Context: 9. Gratuity

The ceiling on gratuity may increase by 25 per cent whenever DA rises by 50 per cent. Emoluments include DA on the date of cessation of service.  
- Rule 45, Rule 10 (1-B), CCS (TS) Rules, 1965 and GID (4), Rule 45, Pension Rules.  
3. Death Gratuity is admissible in the case of death in service of an employee at the following rates:-
